subject: Clarifying the spring deadlines
text: Hi, I hope you are doing well. I am writing because I want to clarify the deadlines for the club's spring program, especially the planning meeting and the final venue form. On my calendar, the venue form is due before the committee reviews the budget, but I recall you saying it can wait until after the meeting. I may have misunderstood, so I wanted to ask rather than assume. If the form is truly flexible, we can adjust our internal timeline without much difficulty. If not, we should probably treat it as urgent and finish it this week. I realize we have slightly different ideas about how strict the campus office is, and I do not want to push a schedule that feels too tight. At the same time, I would rather be cautious because last year the room assignment changed at the last minute. Also, please ignore any earlier note I sent about waiting until next month; I think it may have crossed wires with another event. That part was not fully thought through on my end. If you need me to hold off before changing anything, just say so, and I will leave the notes alone for now. Could you confirm the exact date, whether any drafts must be submitted beforehand, and whether our subgroup should meet sooner? Once we agree on that, I can update the shared notes.
